entities.name: MCP_Developer_Guide
observations: Purpose: MCP server configuration and runtime best-practices for development IDEs
Covers: VS Code, JetBrains, Windsurf, Cursor IDEs
LLM Connectors: GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex, Google Gemini/Vertex, Amazon Q
Security: Never store secrets in workspace files, use IDE secret stores or OS-level secret managers
Config: Use ${workspaceFolder} not absolute paths in .vscode/mcp.json
Architecture: Run MCP servers in separate processes (wrapper script + stdio or network)
VS Code: Workspace file .vscode/mcp.json for shareable configs, user file ~/.kiro/settings/mcp.json for tokens
Health Checks: MCP servers expose health/readiness path (HTTP endpoint or stdio handshake)
Observability: Keep logs accessible, emit lightweight telemetry and request metrics (opt-in)
Rate Limiting: Client-side throttling with exponential backoff + local fallback
Troubleshooting: Duplicate MCP server issues from Docker-managed MCP stack vs stdio servers
Solution: Disable Docker MCP extension or stop Docker-managed MCP stack to avoid duplicates
Wrapper Script: scripts/mcp-stdio-wrapper.js for cross-platform command compatibility
Related: memory.instructions.md, mimir.md, VS Code SecretStorage docs
Status: Active developer guide for ICTServe MCP configuration

entities.name: GitHub_MCP_Server_Setup
observations: Purpose: Run official GitHub MCP Server locally using Docker
Requirements: Docker Desktop/Engine running, GitHub Personal Access Token (PAT)
Security: Store PAT securely when prompted, never commit tokens
Configuration: Use .vscode/mcp.json workspace file to start server from IDE
Manual Docker Run: docker run -i --rm -e GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN=<PAT> ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server
Toolsets: Limit capabilities with GITHUB_TOOLSETS (repos, issues, pull_requests, actions, code_security)
Read-Only Mode: Use GITHUB_READ_ONLY=1 env var for safe experimentation
Troubleshooting: 'dial unix pipe dockerBackendApiServer' error means Docker Desktop not running
PCTX Integration: Code Mode for 90-98% token reduction (macOS/Linux only, Windows not supported)
PCTX Alternatives: WSL2 (recommended), Direct Mimir MCP (current), GitHub Codespaces
Token Usage: PCTX Code Mode 500-2K tokens vs Direct Mimir MCP 5K-50K tokens
Windows Limitation: PCTX npm package only supports macOS (Apple Silicon/Intel) and Linux (ARM64/x64)
Helper Script: scripts/start-mimir-and-wait.ps1 for reliable Neo4j and Mimir startup
Related: .vscode/mcp.json, Mimir PCTX Integration Guide
Status: Active setup guide for GitHub MCP Server with PCTX status

entities.name: Production_Deployment_Checklist
observations: Purpose: Comprehensive deployment checklist for ICTServe production environment
System Requirements: PHP 8.2.12+, Nginx 1.18+/Apache 2.4+, MySQL 8.0+/MariaDB 10.6+, Node.js 18.x+
Server Config: 2GB RAM minimum (4GB+ recommended), 10GB storage minimum (50GB+ recommended)
Security: SSL certificate required, UFW firewall configuration, Fail2Ban setup
Environment: APP_ENV=production, APP_DEBUG=false, secure session cookies, HTTPS enforced
Database: Create ictserve database with utf8mb4_unicode_ci collation, dedicated user with privileges
Deployment: composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader, npm ci --production, npm run build
Permissions: www-data:www-data ownership, 755 for directories, 644 for files, 775 for storage/bootstrap/cache
Nginx Config: HTTPS redirect, SSL TLS 1.2/1.3, security headers, gzip compression, 10M upload limit
Optimization: PHP-FPM tuning (pm=dynamic, max_children=50), Laravel caching (config/route/view/event)
Database Indexes: Add indexes for status, priority, user_id, created_at on helpdesk_tickets and loan_applications
Queue Worker: Systemd service ictserve-worker.service with auto-restart, 3 tries, 1-hour max time
Backup: Daily automated backups (database + files), 30-day retention, /var/backups/ictserve location
Monitoring: Health check script every 5 minutes, log rotation (52 days), queue monitoring
Post-Deployment: Functionality tests (login, dashboard, helpdesk, loans, email, reports, search, mobile)
Security Tests: HTTPS enforcement, security headers, authentication, CSRF, file upload validation, SQL injection protection
Performance Tests: Page load < 3s, database query performance, memory usage, cache mechanisms
Rollback: Application and database rollback procedures with backup restoration
Maintenance: Daily (logs, disk space, backups, queue), Weekly (security, updates, SSL), Monthly (dependencies, audit)
Related: D07 System Integration Plan, D11 Technical Design, deployment-guide.md
Status: Active production deployment checklist v3.0.0

entities.name: Performance_Optimization_Guide
observations: Purpose: Comprehensive performance optimization for ICTServe to meet Core Web Vitals targets
Performance Targets: LCP < 2.5s, FID < 100ms, CLS < 0.1, TTFB < 600ms
Lighthouse Scores: 90+ (guest/authenticated), 85+ (admin), 100 (accessibility)
Testing: npm run test:e2e -- tests/e2e/performance/core-web-vitals.spec.ts for automated testing
Image Optimization: Lazy loading (loading=lazy), responsive images (srcset/sizes), WebP format with JPEG fallback
Image Attributes: Use PerformanceOptimizationService->getImageAttributes() for proper lazy loading
Livewire Optimization: OptimizedLivewireComponent trait with cacheData() and optimizeQuery() methods
Query Optimization: Eager loading with select() to avoid N+1 queries, composite indexes for performance
Debounced Input: wire:model.live.debounce.300ms for search inputs, wire:model.lazy for large text fields
Lazy Components: Use #[Lazy] attribute with placeholder() method for heavy components
Caching: Dashboard stats (5-min TTL), asset availability (5-min TTL), cache invalidation patterns
JavaScript: Code splitting with Vite, manual chunks (vendor, livewire), terser minification, drop_console in production
Asset Preloading: generatePreloadTags() for critical CSS/JS/fonts in layout head
Database: Query monitoring (log queries > 1s), composite indexes on user_id+status, single query with grouping
Troubleshooting: High LCP (image optimization), High FID (code splitting), High CLS (explicit dimensions), High TTFB (Redis caching)
Monitoring: Laravel Telescope (local), New Relic/Datadog (production), Google Analytics (Core Web Vitals), Sentry (errors)
Key Metrics: Core Web Vitals, Lighthouse scores, database queries, cache hit rate, memory usage, response times (P50/P95/P99)
Checklist: Pre-deployment (tests, audits, slow queries, cache config), Post-deployment (monitoring, cache rates, error logs)
Related: D07 System Integration Plan, D11 Technical Design, D12 UI/UX Design Guide
Status: Active performance optimization guide v1.0
